accountant_is_configured.meaning: the Vault has an Accountant configured

active_registration_exists_before.meaning: an active registration exists for the target BLP slot before supplyToBlp is called

hypercore_slot_active_after_action.meaning: HyperCore leaves the 0x811 supplied-balance slot readable and active after the accepted action
hypercore_slot_active_after_action.checkpoint: after the accepted action, before notifyVaultSupply

stale_slot_registered.meaning: the stale BLP supplied-balance slot remains registered in vaultSupplied

backing_surplus_accounting_available.meaning: Vault backing/surplus accounting and monitoring are available (reads and settlement do not revert)
backing_surplus_accounting_available.checkpoint: while the slot registration state holds

assumptions: The accepted action 15 is the supplyToBlp action that precedes notifyVaultSupply registration.
The stale slot registration persists while the accounting/monitoring unavailability is claimed.

unresolved.description: Report states the inactive-slot outcome only as a possibility ('if the action is accepted but the slot remains unreadable'); it is not established as an observed prior state, so the potential modality of hypercore_slot_inactive cannot be fully preserved by a Boolean precondition.
Report does not define the concrete observable that constitutes 'backing/surplus accounting and monitoring unavailable' beyond reverting reads/settlement; represented as a single grounded Boolean.

limitations: The safety relation is stated as a liveness obligation: under the reported preconditions the accounting/monitoring must remain available; the report's conditional/potential nature of the inactive slot is only approximated by a Boolean precondition.
No numeric bounds or units are supplied by the report; all observables are qualitative Booleans.
Authorization/permissionless status of the operator is not asserted and is not encoded.
